content.summary: In “Make five employees unavailable”, the simulation finishes all work 592.5 hours after it starts, producing 3,228 stones at a total cost of INR 1,172,316.29. 17 of 29 orders are delayed. The primary bottleneck is Polishing. Compared with “Current factory operations”, “Make five employees unavailable” changes completion time by +245.8 hours (+70.9%), total cost by +INR 315,964.29 (+36.9%), delayed orders by +7 orders (+70.0%).
keyChanges: Completion time: 346.7 hours to 592.5 hours (+245.8 hours, +70.9%), worsened.
Cost per output stone: INR 265.30 per stone to INR 363.19 per stone (+INR 97.89 per stone, +36.9%), worsened.
Throughput: 33.2 stones per hour to 18.5 stones per hour (-14.6 stones per hour, -44.1%), worsened.
Orders delayed: 10 orders to 17 orders (+7 orders, +70.0%), worsened.
On-time delivery rate: 65.5% to 41.4% (-24.1 percentage points, -36.8%), worsened.
risks: Delayed orders: SDW-0021 (LATE), SDW-0024 (LATE), SDW-0028 (LATE), SDW-0029 (LATE), SDW-0030 (LATE) and others.
Working time spent waiting worsens by +1,234.0 hours.
Throughput worsens by -14.6 stones per hour.
Cost per output stone worsens by +INR 97.89 per stone.
content.bottleneckExplanation: Polishing is the primary bottleneck. Its busiest required pool, Polishers, is busy 85.8% of the available time. Jobs wait 46.4 hours there on average, and the queue averages 9.6 jobs.

recommendations.title: Simulate more capacity for Polishers
recommendations.rationale: Polishing is the primary bottleneck and Polishers is busy 85.8%. Create a scenario that adds units to it, run it and compare the result.

recommendations.title: Review the allocation of Intake clerks
recommendations.rationale: Intake clerks is busy only 2.9% of its available time; some of its capacity may be better used elsewhere. Simulate the reallocation before changing anything.

recommendations.title: Review the allocation of Dispatch clerks
recommendations.rationale: Dispatch clerks is busy only 4.9% of its available time; some of its capacity may be better used elsewhere. Simulate the reallocation before changing anything.

recommendations.title: Look at the delayed orders first
recommendations.rationale: 17 orders finish late or not at all, including SDW-0021, SDW-0024, SDW-0028. Simulate an extra shift or more capacity at the bottleneck to see whether they would finish on time.

assumptions: Figures are simulated estimates from recorded history and configuration under the simulation's fixed rules; they are not guarantees.
The simulation starts at 2026-11-09 18:03 UTC and uses algorithm 1.0.0.
Differences are “Make five employees unavailable” minus “Current factory operations”.
